title: Gold question set
description: Hand-labelled questions for the S6.14 answer-quality harness. Pinned to a corpus PDF checksum exactly like the gold roster and gold relations.

judge_prompt_version.description: The api/ops/answer_judge.py judge prompt version this set's expectations were written against. Informational only -- the judge itself is versioned in code, not per gold set.

expect_abstain.description: True only for the unanswerable class -- a correct answer here is abstention, not a hedge.

expected_answer.description: A short reference answer for the judge to compare against. Required unless expect_abstain is true.

expected_entities.description: Canonical roster names the answer must resolve to exactly (aggregation class) -- e.g. Mr Bennet's five daughters. Scored as an exact set match, never a plausible subset.

min_citations.description: Every factual claim must carry a citation (query-path.md); 0 only for expect_abstain questions.
